mapper.select: SELECT cs.*, s.student_no, u.real_name as student_name, c.course_name, u2.real_name as teacher_name FROM course_selections cs LEFT JOIN students s ON cs.student_id = s.id LEFT JOIN users u ON s.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN courses c ON cs.course_id = c.id LEFT JOIN teachers t ON cs.teacher_id = t.id LEFT JOIN users u2 ON t.user_id = u2.id WHERE cs.id = #{id}

SELECT cs.*, s.student_no, u.real_name as student_name, c.course_name, u2.real_name as teacher_name FROM course_selections cs LEFT JOIN students s ON cs.student_id = s.id LEFT JOIN users u ON s.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN courses c ON cs.course_id = c.id LEFT JOIN teachers t ON cs.teacher_id = t.id LEFT JOIN users u2 ON t.user_id = u2.id WHERE cs.student_id = #{studentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course_selections (student_id, course_id, teacher_id, semester, status) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{courseId}, #{teacherId}, #{semester}, #{status})
